name: ixitek
description: Ixitek Solutions — deployed as ONE Node.js Web App. ixitek-backend (Express) serves its own /api/* routes AND the built ixitek-frontend (React/Vite) production bundle from a single origin, e.g. https://ixitek.com. Root scripts only orchestrate the two existing sub-projects (ixitek-frontend/package.json, ixitek-backend/package.json) — neither was changed in shape.

scripts.build: npm install --prefix ixitek-backend --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix ixitek-frontend --no-audit --no-fund --include=dev && npm run build --prefix ixitek-frontend
